'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 John Veasey LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
